description: Explore the collection of startup and shutdown sounds used in various versions of Windows operating systems. This application also has startup and shutdown sounds from unreleased versions of Windows, including Windows NT 5.0 beta and Windows Longhorn! Get great insight and fun facts on various sounds from the "Did you Know" boxes. Enjoy beautiful pictures, many of which show the packaging of the retail release of a particular Windows version.
